title: Cauldron Cubes
description: Store and interact with Sulfur Cubes inside cauldrons
body:
![Ice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d26bdca9e376897b8d9bbf5728ddce894eac378.webp)

## **About**
**Cauldron Cubes** is a mod that modifies cauldrons, letting you store and interact with sulfur cubes


## **Features**
- Store a Sulfur Cube inside a cauldron
- Swap or shear out its absorbed block
- And other interactions

## **Requirements**
The Fabric version requires Fabric API
